NGUKURR – CLOSING THE HEALTH GAP

Ngukurr is a remote Indigenous township in the Northern Territory of Australia. Like many communities in the region, it faces challenges in accessing timely and culturally safe healthcare. Distance from major hospitals, language barriers, and limited services often make it difficult for residents to receive proper treatment and ongoing support. Our project, the Smart Adaptive Clinical Assistant (SACA), aims to bridge this gap. SACA helps Indigenous people connect more easily with medical services by providing:

  • Translating local languages into English.
  • Detecting sickness from voice or text.
  • Connecting communities to healthcare more easily.
